hook.en: At midnight you can order a book, book a bus ticket and pay your electricity bill from your phone. Business has moved onto the internet.
hook.kn: ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಫೋನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಬಸ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದಿರಿಸಬಹುದು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಬಿಲ್ ಪಾವತಿಸಬಹುದು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಸಾಗಿದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the scope of e-business: B2B, B2C, intra-B and C2C

narration.en: At midnight you can order a book, book a bus ticket and pay your electricity bill from your phone. Business has moved onto the internet.
narration.kn: ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಫೋನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಬಸ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದಿರಿಸಬಹುದು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಬಿಲ್ ಪಾವತಿಸಬಹುದು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಸಾಗಿದೆ.

body.en: E-business is the conduct of industry, trade and commerce using computer networks. E-commerce, the buying and selling part, is only a subset of it. Its scope covers B2B transactions between firms, B2C transactions between firms and customers, intra-B transactions within a firm, and C2C transactions between consumers.

narration.en: E-business is the conduct of industry, trade and commerce using computer networks. E-commerce, the buying and selling part, is only a subset of it. Its scope covers B2B transactions between firms, B2C transactions between firms and customers, intra-B transactions within a firm, and C2C transactions between consumers.
narration.kn: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನಡೆಸುವುದೇ ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ. ಇ-ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಅದರ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ. ಬಿ2ಬಿ, ಬಿ2ಸಿ, ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿ2ಸಿ ಇದರ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ.

body.en: An e-business is easier and cheaper to form, needs no physical presence, and its location hardly matters. It has direct contact with suppliers and customers, faster internal communication, shorter business cycles and easy access to global markets. However, it offers less personal touch, no physical sampling of products, and higher transaction risk.

points.en: Less personal touch; higher transaction risk

narration.kn: ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಸುಲಭ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೆಚ್ಚದ್ದು, ಭೌತಿಕ ಉಪಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ, ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸುಲಭ. ಆದರೆ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

problem.en: Classify each transaction: (a) a hotel books 500 kg of rice from a wholesaler's portal, (b) you buy a phone cover from a company's app, (c) a firm's HR team posts salary slips on its intranet, (d) you sell your old guitar to another person on a classifieds site.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Classify each transaction: (a) a hotel books 500 kg of rice from a wholesaler's portal, (b) you buy a phone cover from a company's app, (c) a firm's HR team posts salary slips on its intranet, (d) you sell your old guitar to another person on a classifieds site.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: E-business uses computer networks for all business processes.
points.kn: ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಎಲ್ಲ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: E-commerce is only the buying-and-selling part of e-business.
Scope: B2B, B2C, intra-B and C2C.

points.en: E-business is cheaper to set up but lacks personal touch.
points.kn: ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಅಗ್ಗ, ಆದರೆ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

homework.en: Compare e-business and traditional business on six points.

narration.en: Recap. E-business uses computer networks for all business processes. E-commerce is only the buying-and-selling part of e-business. Scope: B2B, B2C, intra-B and C2C. E-business is cheaper to set up but lacks personal touch.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಎಲ್ಲ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಜಾಲ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇ-ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಖರೀದಿ–ಮಾರಾಟ ಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ. ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ: ಬಿ2ಬಿ, ಬಿ2ಸಿ, ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿ2ಸಿ. ಇ-ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಅಗ್ಗ, ಆದರೆ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕಡಿಮೆ.
